Method of Attack: Malicious OAuth applications used to send authorization requests to high-ranking executives
Use of OAuth tokens to send emails from compromised accounts within the same organization
Manipulation of Reply URL to lock victims on consent screen until permission is granted
Potential man-in-the-middle proxy attacks to compromise account credentials
Impacted Systems: Office 365 accounts of company executives and general managers
Indicators of Compromise: Authorization requests sent from compromised Office 365 accounts
